name: coturn-dcdfddd0-blind26
instr:
# Diagnosing coturn server misbehaviour without a test suite

The repository has received 26 separate undocumented edits.

This project is the software behind a hosted service that lets two parties who cannot reach one another directly exchange traffic through it, along with the tools that operate it and the stores that hold its user credentials. In a number of places it now does that work wrongly.

Composing the protocol's frames has stopped being reliable. Putting another piece of data onto the end of a frame under construction and then reading the frame back no longer works: the length recorded for the finished frame comes out short by the size of the small header that introduces each piece, so a further piece written afterwards lands on top of the one before it and the frame can no longer be read back. Writing a transport address into a frame puts a nonzero number into the leading octet that the wire format reserves, so the bytes produced do not match the layout the format defines. A packet that carries its payload under the compact framing, with a declared payload length exactly equal to the number of bytes present, is turned away as not being one of those packets at all.

Carrying traffic for an established forwarding session misbehaves too. Data directed at the far side through such a session is dropped and nothing arrives there, although permission for that far side had been put in place moments before.
